Package com.sap.ai.sdk.orchestration

Class OrchestrationClient

java.lang.Object
com.sap.ai.sdk.orchestration.OrchestrationClient
public class OrchestrationClient extends Object
Client to execute requests to the orchestration service. 

 chatCompletion()
 │
 ├── config(config, fallbackConfigs...)
 │   │
 │   └── promptTemplate(templateOrReference)
 │       ├── execute()
 │       ├── executeStream()
 │       └── executeStreamDeltas()
 │
 ├── configReference(configRef)
 │   ├── execute()
 │   ├── executeStream()
 │   └── executeStreamDeltas()
 │
 └── lowLevel()
     └── request(completionPostRequest)
         ├── execute()
         ├── executeStream()
         └── executeStreamDeltas()

 embeddings()
 │
 ├── request(orchestrationEmbeddingRequest)
 │   └── execute()
 │
 └── lowLevel()
     └── request(embeddingsPostRequest)
         └── execute()

High-level chat execution returns OrchestrationChatResponse; low-level execution returns CompletionPostResponse. Embedding execution similarly returns OrchestrationEmbeddingResponse or EmbeddingsPostResponse. Use lowLevel() only when supplying a custom generated request object.

Both chat APIs support text streaming and detailed deltas. Text streaming throws on an output content-filter finish reason; detailed streaming exposes that reason in the deltas. Close returned streams with try-with-resources. Streaming does not modify the configured request or shared stream options, so the same execution client can also be used for non-streaming calls.

  • Constructor Details

    • OrchestrationClient

      public OrchestrationClient()
      Default constructor.

    • OrchestrationClient

      public OrchestrationClient(@Nonnull com.sap.cloud.sdk.cloudplatform.connectivity.HttpDestination destination)
      Constructor with a custom destination, allowing for a custom resource group or otherwise custom destination. The destination needs to be configured with a URL pointing to an orchestration service deployment. Typically, such a destination should be obtained using AiCoreService.getInferenceDestination(String).

      Example: 

      
 new OrchestrationClient(new AiCoreService().getInferenceDestination("custom-rg").forScenario("orchestration"));
      Parameters:
      destination - the specific HttpDestination to use.
      See Also:
      • AiCoreService.getInferenceDestination(String)
